$description.en_us: Data-driven Block Aura definition from MiXianTu.
$description.zh_cn: 由觅仙途数据包加载的方块灵气定义。

$description.en_us: One block this entry covers, or one block tag standing for several.
$description.zh_cn: 本条覆盖的一个方块，或代表若干方块的一个方块标签。

$description.en_us: Blocks this entry applies to. At least one, and the list may mix block ids with #tags.
$description.zh_cn: 本条生效的方块。至少一项，可以混写方块 ID 与 #标签。

$description.en_us: What one resource contributes per matching block, or what the zone holds of it.
$description.zh_cn: 每个匹配方块对某一种资源的贡献，或该区域持有的该种灵气。

$description.en_us: Map keyed by mxt:resource ids. Each resource contributes independently, and each matching block adds its own entry.
$description.zh_cn: 以 mxt:resource ID 为键的表。每种资源独立贡献，每个匹配方块各加一份。

$description.en_us: Aura kinds every matching block contributes, used for aura type checks.
$description.zh_cn: 每个匹配方块贡献的灵气类型，用于灵气类型判断。

$description.en_us: One block id, or one block tag prefixed with #.
$description.zh_cn: 一个方块 ID，或一个以 # 开头的方块标签。

$description.en_us: A block tag id prefixed with #.
$description.zh_cn: 以 # 开头的方块标签 ID。
